회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
쿠팡의 Global Investigations Team(글로벌 조사팀)은 쿠팡 그룹 전체의 조사 업무를 전담하는 조직으로, 쿠팡 및 국내외 계열사에서 발생할 수 있는 사기(Fraud), 비위행위(Misconduct), 정책 위반(Policy Violations) 및 기타 비윤리적 행위와 관련된 리스크를 식별, 평가 및 완화하는 역할을 수행합니다. 글로벌 조사팀은 윤리 제보 채널을 관장하고, 이를 통해 접수된 윤리 위반 사안에 대해 독립적이고 객관적인 조사를 수행하며, 사실관계를 규명하고 적절한 조치 및 개선 방안을 도출합니다. 또한 해외 자회사의 조사 활동을 지원하고, 그룹 차원의 조사 기준과 운영 원칙이 일관되게 적용될 수 있도록 총괄합니다.
현재 쿠팡 글로벌 조사팀에서는 Principal 조사 전문가를 채용하고 있습니다. 본 포지션은 복잡하고 민감한 조사 사안을 독립적으로 평가하고 수행하며, 우수한 판단력과 분석력을 바탕으로 조사 전 과정을 주도할 수 있는 전문가를 대상으로 합니다.
업무 내용
중앙 제보 채널을 통해 접수된 내부 제보를 독립적으로 검토하고, 사실관계와 잠재적 리스크를 평가하여 조사 착수 여부 및 조사 범위를 결정합니다.
조사 계획 수립, 인터뷰, 증거 수집, 회사 시스템 및 데이터 검토, 사실관계 분석, 조사 결과 도출 및 최종 보고서 작성까지 조사 전 과정을 독립적으로 수행 또는 주도합니다.
회사 시스템, 거래 데이터, 시스템 로그, HR 데이터 및 기타 관련 정보를 활용하여 이상 징후를 식별하고 조사 가설을 수립·검증합니다.
사실관계, 증거의 신뢰성 및 리스크를 객관적으로 평가하여 균형 잡힌 결론과 권고안을 제시합니다.
횡령, 배임, 이해상충, 부패 등 Fraud 및 Compliance 관련 사건과 직장 내 괴롭힘, 차별, 보복 행위, 성희롱 등 HR 관련 사건을 조사합니다.
복잡하고 민감한 사안에 대해 독립적인 판단력을 바탕으로 공정성, 일관성 및 객관성을 유지하며 조사를 수행합니다.
국내외 주요 이해관계자와 협업하고, 필요 시 해외 자회사의 조사 활동을 지원합니다.

jobs.description: ROLE SUMMARY: The key strategic focus within the Internal Medicine Research Unit (IMRU) is identifying novel therapies to prevent or treat metabolic diseases such as obesity and cardiovascular disease. Our goal is to build a world-class research team of dedicated scientists committed to developing a deep mechanistic understanding of the metabolic pathways underlying disease pathogenesis. As a senior scientific leader and member of the obesity discovery biology team, this individual will play a significant role in shaping the scientific direction for the obesity therapeutic area and influencing broader IMRU research strategy and portfolio priorities. The individual will help create and drive discovery research strategy across multiple programs, including target ideation, validation, translational biomarker strategy, hypothesis testing, and early clinical development within the IMRU obesity portfolio. The successful candidate will lead through both direct team leadership and influence across multidisciplinary partners, helping align scientific decisions across discovery biology, translational sciences, clinical, computational, and external collaborators. The individual will identify emerging therapeutic opportunities, advance portfolio programs with scientific rigor and urgency, and represent research strategies to internal leadership and the external scientific community. Knowledge and experience in the study of metabolic pathways are essential, and familiarity with the pathophysiology of dysmetabolic states would be advantageous. Strong self-motivation, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to lead, mentor, and build scientific capability in a highly collaborative environment are essential. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES: Shape and influence the scientific direction for discovery research programs aligned with IMRU therapeutic area and portfolio strategy. Apply creative thinking and scientific expertise to formulate strategies that identify, prioritize, and validate therapeutic targets in key areas of interest to the Internal Medicine Research Unit. Maintain awareness of cutting-edge scientific and technical developments in preclinical-to-clinical translation and apply these insights to advance portfolio programs and identify emerging opportunities. Guide research priorities across multiple programs by integrating mechanistic biology, translational feasibility, biomarker strategy, and portfolio impact. Conceptualize, design, and oversee rigorous in vivo, ex vivo, and in vitro studies, including experimental design, data collection, interpretation, and presentation. Quantify and translate experimental results to advance understanding of how metabolic pathways and complex physiological systems are altered by disease and respond to therapeutic intervention. Lead a research team of lab heads and scientists, providing supervision, coaching, and mentorship to develop skills essential to rigorous scientific research and drug discovery execution. Lead through influence across multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders, driving scientific alignment and decision-making where accountability extends beyond direct reporting lines. Build and facilitate strategic collaborations with partners in the academic scientific community, the broader Pfizer network, and external experts to strengthen scientific insight and portfolio impact. Establish external scientific leadership through peer-reviewed publications, scientific presentations, conference engagement, and thought leadership in relevant areas of metabolic disease biology. Present and represent research programs, portfolio recommendations, and scientific strategy to Pfizer leadership and governance forums. Ensure that all research and discovery work is conducted with the highest quality and ethical standards and in accordance with relevant regulatory, QC, and compliance guidelines. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: PhD, MD, or MD/PhD with postdoctoral research experience and 12+ years of experience leading research groups and supervising scientists in an industry or academic setting. Successful track record of scientific achievement through high-impact publications, presentations, and recognized contributions to the scientific community. Demonstrated ability to critically review complex data, think creatively, formulate novel hypotheses, and translate scientific insight into actionable discovery strategy. Deep expertise in metabolism and/or signaling pathways relevant to obesity (CNS neurocircuitry or peripheral metabolism), with the ability to apply mechanistic insight to therapeutic target identification and validation. Experience performing and/or leading in vitro, in vivo, and ex vivo experiments relevant to metabolic disease biology. Demonstrated ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders, including the ability to drive decisions and align priorities without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to contribute to and advance multiple projects in parallel with learning agility, scientific rigor, and portfolio-level judgment. Experience developing scientific talent through mentorship, coaching, and building organizational capability. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to represent research strategy and portfolio recommendations to scientific, governance, and leadership audiences. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS: Some travel to scientific conferences and other Pfizer sites expected. ADDITIONAL DETAILS: Last date to apply is October 8, 2026 Work Location Assignment: This is a hybrid role requiring you to live within commuting distance and work on-site an average of 2.5 days per week. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $162,900.00 to $271,500.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O-1, H-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Grâce à une collaboration transversale étroite avec les équipes de Planification, d’Approvisionnement stratégique, de Logistique entrante, des Opérations des centres de distribution, des TI et d’Analytique, le/la Gestionnaire principal(e) anticipe les risques, mène l’amélioration continue et assure l’alignement entre la gouvernance, l’exécution et les engagements en matière de niveau de service. Section A – Responsabilités spécifiques Performance du niveau de service et habilitation de la gouvernance Assurer la responsabilité des analyses de performance, des indicateurs et de la gouvernance liés aux leviers d’exécution et au niveau de service, en identifiant les risques, les tendances et les opportunités d’amélioration structurelle dans le périmètre sous responsabilité. Traduire des analyses complexes en messages clairs et prêts pour les exécutifs, en présentant les arbitrages, les causes fondamentales et des recommandations appuyées par les données afin de soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Définir et opérationnaliser un modèle de gouvernance de la performance pour les Opérations d’approvisionnement, incluant les définitions des KPI, la cadence de reddition de comptes, les mécanismes d’escalade et les forums de revue avec la direction. Collaborer avec les équipes TI et Analytique pour améliorer les rapports, tableaux de bord et la visibilité de la performance, soutenant ainsi la gouvernance, les revues de leadership et la qualité durable des décisions. Gestion et gouvernance du cycle de vie des fournisseurs Définir et faire évoluer les cadres de gouvernance soutenant l’inscription et l’intégration des fournisseurs. Assurer l’alignement des activités liées au cycle de vie des fournisseurs avec les stratégies globales de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de l’entreprise. Identifier et piloter des opportunités de simplification visant à réduire la complexité opérationnelle et à renforcer les contrôles. Faciliter la coordination et la communication entre l’équipe de gouvernance des fournisseurs, la Planification de l’approvisionnement et les équipes de Stratégie d’approvisionnement. Superviser le respect des politiques de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, des obligations contractuelles et des normes de conformité. Agir comme point d’escalade pour les enjeux liés aux fournisseurs et assurer leur résolution rapide via des mécanismes de gouvernance structurés. Promouvoir une culture d’agilité, de responsabilisation et d’innovation au sein de la fonction de gouvernance des fournisseurs et auprès des parties prenantes clés. Gestion et gouvernance du portefeuille et du cycle de vie des produits Assurer une supervision stratégique des processus d’inscription et de retrait des produits afin de garantir l’alignement avec les objectifs du portefeuille et les capacités des fournisseurs. Mettre en place et maintenir des cadres de gouvernance permettant une exécution cohérente, efficace et conforme des activités d’inscription et de retrait. Assurer une coordination transversale étroite avec les équipes telles que la Gestion des catégories, la Planification de l’approvisionnement, les Ventes et la Stratégie d’approvisionnement afin de soutenir des transitions fluides et de minimiser les perturbations. Surveiller et valider l’exactitude des données relatives aux dossiers produits, en assurant des mises à jour en temps opportun dans les systèmes et une visibilité complète à travers la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Soutenir la prise de décision en révisant les propositions d’inscription et de retrait, en évaluant les impacts opérationnels et en assurant l’alignement avec les stratégies globales de l’entreprise et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Identifier et atténuer les risques opérationnels, mener des analyses post‑mortem et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action. Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration des processus afin de simplifier les flux de travail, réduire la complexité et accroître la réactivité face aux changements d’affaires. Gouvernance et pilotage logistique Surveiller et soutenir l’exécution des activités liées aux allocations fournisseurs, à la disponibilité des produits et à l’intégrité des données dans les systèmes. Fournir l’orientation et la supervision nécessaires pour assurer une gestion exacte et ponctuelle des données produits et fournisseurs soutenant les opérations logistiques. jobs.description: TL;DR — We're looking for a contract Content Designer who can write both inside the product and across the website. You'll own the words in onboarding, empty states, and error messaging, and partner with PMM and our external design partner on the copy and structure of lovable.dev http://lovable.dev. This is a full-time engagement. WHY LOVABLE? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured - Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result - Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline. - The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it - A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it - Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them - Comfort partnering with an external design agency as well as internal marketing and design stakeholders - Genuine full-time capacity for the length of the contract. We move fast and this needs to be your primary focus - Ideally - content strategy chops. Strategy and SEO aren't the core scope here, but the instincts show up in the work If you're strong on only one side of this, apply anyway. We know we're describing a rare combination. If you're exceptional at in-product writing and have never touched a marketing site, or you're a brilliant web writer who has never written an error message, we still want to see your work. Tell us which side you're great at and we'll take it from there. WHAT YOU'LL DO In one sentence: Make Lovable sound like one company, in the product and on the website. - Own the copy in the moments that decide whether someone sticks: first run in the editor, empty states, failed and partial builds, upgrade and credit prompts - Name things - features, surfaces, settings - so the product's own vocabulary holds together - Write copy for new and refreshed marketing pages with PMM, making sure current GTM messaging is actually reflected on the site - Work with our external design partner on content hierarchy, categorization, and the top-level navigation. You'll shape it with them rather than own it alone - Diagnose and fix pages that are already designed but not landing, focusing on hierarchy, scannability, and messages that have to work fast - Sit embedded with marketing and design, with full context on how messaging decisions get made across the business HOW WE HIRE 1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter. 2. Send us two pieces of work: ideally one from inside a product and one from the web, or two from whichever side you're strongest on. 3. Walk us through your process and craft in a small number of interviews with the marketing and design team. 4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid, trial work. ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION - Please submit your application in English - it's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join - We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal READY TO JOIN US? Help us unlock human creativity and build the future of software creation.
